crossRefs.note: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
